item.title: Chatman shines off the bench in 84-78 win over Penn State
item.description: It had been 34 days since the last time Taison Chatman scored a point. item.description: Amongst the 169 total fellows elected to the class of 2025 National Academy of Inventors, also known as NAI, three of them are researchers at Ohio State.
